findings: learner.components[1].text: “Their current principal Mandarin readings, nǎ and nà, differ in tone” misidentifies a tone difference as the sound explanation for the proposed phonetic role. Keep the displayed readings, but state that the similar initial and final make a present-day sound comparison; explicitly say that this pair alone does not establish the historical relation. The nǎ–nà pair is supported by X-64841a8b9bf0870b0029, X-c80baa6308c49ea168bb, and X-d7cffdb3300fc36f461e.
